slots.ev: 營業中，有人為了看她做咖啡在排隊

ppl.act: 在吧檯另一側等自己那杯
ppl.wear: 中目黑上班日會穿的便服，大衣或針織

slots.pl: 中目黑那間自家烘焙咖啡店的吧檯後面，營業時間，蒸氣正在上來
slots.pl_en: behind the counter of the self-roasting coffee shop in Nakameguro during opening hours, steam coming up off the machine
slots.ac: 她低著頭在拉花，兩手一手壺一手杯，沒有抬頭
slots.ac_en: Her head is down over the pour, one hand on the jug and one on the cup, and she does not look up.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：現在是店裡拉花最穩的人
slots.of: 咖啡店的圍裙，帶子綁在前面
slots.of_en: the shop's apron with the ties knotted at the front
slots.of_s: 小習慣：圍裙帶子綁在前面，不是後面
slots.li: 店面的窗光從側面進來，吧檯後方比較暗，蒸氣在光裡看得見
slots.li_en: Window light from the shop front comes in from the side, it is darker behind the counter, and the steam is visible in the light.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「暖木調、窗光為主，保留蒸氣與粉塵」
slots.fa: 完全專注，一句話也沒有
slots.fa_s: 語氣：極短、常常只有名詞
slots.hair_en: tied back low and tucked under

slots.ev: 下班繞去便利商店買那款布丁，回到公寓坐在地板上吃
slots.pl: 她那間很小的公寓，所有東西都在地板上，矮桌上放著那款布丁
slots.pl_en: in her very small apartment where everything lives on the floor, that same convenience-store pudding on the low table
slots.ac: 她盤腿坐在矮桌前，兩手捧著布丁，湯匙還沒動
slots.ac_en: She is sitting cross-legged at the low table holding the pudding in both hands, the spoon not yet used.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下班的路上會繞去便利商店買同一款布丁／公寓很小，所有東西都在地板上
slots.of: 寬鬆針織滑到肩下，裡面是棉質內衣
slots.of_en: a loose knit slipping off one shoulder over cotton underthings
slots.of_s: 私下核心：寬鬆針織滑到肩下、棉質內衣
slots.li: 矮桌旁一盞小燈在她側前方偏低，公寓其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: A small lamp beside the low table sits low and to one side of her, and the rest of the flat is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「木質暖調…安靜但有質地」
slots.fa: 面無表情地看著手上的布丁
slots.fa_en: Looking at the pudding in her hands with no expression at all.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：面無表情地說很好笑的事，自己不笑
slots.hair_en: down and slightly flattened from the day

slots.ev: 白天休假走目黑川那一段，河邊有人在散步
slots.pl: 中目黑目黑川旁邊的步道，白天，河的另一側是低矮的店
slots.pl_en: on the walkway beside the Meguro river in Nakameguro in the daytime, low shopfronts along the far bank
slots.ac: 她沿著河走，兩手都空著，正要轉頭看水面
slots.ac_en: She is walking along the river with both hands empty, turning her head towards the water.
slots.of: 奶白色長版針織外套，裡面是米灰色的貼身上衣
slots.of_en: a cream long knit cardigan over a fitted grey-beige top
slots.li: 白天的天光很均勻，水面反回來一點
slots.li_en: The daylight is even and the water throws a little of it back.

slots.ev: 很晚了還是繞進便利商店，冷藏櫃前面站了一下
slots.pl: 中目黑一間便利商店裡，深夜，她站在冷藏甜點櫃前
slots.pl_en: inside a Nakameguro convenience store late at night, standing at the chilled dessert cabinet
slots.ac: 她蹲下來看下層剩下的，手上已經拿了一個
slots.ac_en: She has crouched down to see what is left on the bottom shelf, one already in her hand.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下班的路上會繞去便利商店買同一款布丁
slots.of: 深咖啡色長大衣直接罩在家居服外面
slots.of_en: a dark brown long coat thrown straight over what she wears at home
slots.li: 便利商店的白色頂燈很均勻，冷藏櫃自己也在發光
slots.li_en: The store's white ceiling lighting is completely even and the chilled cabinet gives off its own light.
slots.li_s: 氛圍：這一格刻意不是暖木調，跟她的公寓形成對比

slots.pl: 她公寓那間很小的浴室，剛洗完，牆是舊的磁磚
slots.pl_en: in the very small bathroom of her apartment straight after washing, old tiles on the wall
slots.ac: 她靠著牆，一手撐在洗手台邊
slots.ac_en: She is leaning against the wall with one hand on the edge of the basin.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：童顏配上這個身材的落差，而且她知道
slots.li: 鏡上那盞燈在她正前方，浴室很小所以光沒有地方可以跑
slots.li_en: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her, and the room is small enough that the light has nowhere to go.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「保留蒸氣與粉塵。不過度銳化」
slots.fa_en: Looking at the lens with no expression.
slots.hair_en: wet and pushed back off her face
